summary: Tested Emergent Object Storage campaign assets + Qikberry/Qikchat WhatsApp integration (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL - cloud-assets status returns brochure=true/prospects=true, manual upload works and is idempotent, GET /api/campaigns returns the Myntra campaign (91 total = 91 pending, attachment_cloud_path set correctly), GET /api/campaigns/7701ea79/prospects returns seeded rows with no _id leakage, /api/whatsapp/config returns configured=true, /api/whatsapp/stats and /api/whatsapp/messages return valid shapes, and /api/whatsapp/send + /send-bulk correctly 400 on missing phone/message/contacts. Verified the real Qikchat API is reachable: one controlled send to +910000000000 returned {status:true, 'Messages queued successfully', credits:0} and was logged to Mongo (test row deleted afterwards). Frontend: agent password gate ('Access' + Agent@2024!) works, nav-whatsapp loads the WhatsApp view, all compose testids render (phone/name/message/send/contact-search/toggle-history), send button correctly disabled until phone+message present, char counter updates, CRM contact picker returns 8 live suggestions, history toggle expands/collapses and rendered the logged message row, and Campaigns view still renders 91 total / 91 pending / 0 sent / 0 failed with a 50-row prospects table. No console errors, no error elements on any tested screen.

minor.issue: No phone format validation. Any string is accepted and blindly prefixed with +91 (e.g. 'abcd' -> '+91abcd') and forwarded to Qikchat, burning an API call. Add a regex/E.164 check before calling the provider.

Message is logged as status='sent' purely because Qikchat returned 'queued successfully' (my send to the invalid number +910000000000 was recorded as 'sent'). There is no delivery-status webhook/poll, so the sent/failed stats are optimistic and misleading.

Updates a module-level global only; not persisted and lost on reload/restart. Also the response claims success without validating the key against Qikchat. GET /config reads the module constant, so a runtime update is inconsistent across workers.
Untyped `data: dict` bodies - no Pydantic model, so no schema validation/OpenAPI contract.
Sends sequentially with no rate limiting/throttling and no cap on contacts count - a large payload will block the request for minutes and can trip provider limits.

Uses blocking `requests` calls (object_storage.py) inside an async endpoint, blocking the event loop; it also downloads the full 486KB PDF + 106KB XLSX just to test existence. Use a HEAD/metadata call and run it via asyncio.to_thread.

ui_bugs.issue: VIEW_TITLES had no 'whatsapp' entry, so the header showed 'Dashboard' while the WhatsApp view was active. FIXED by me (added whatsapp: 'WhatsApp'); verified header now reads 'WhatsApp'.

integration_issues.issue: Most CRM connections have no phone number. Selecting such a contact silently clears the phone input (setPhone(c.phone || '')) and leaves Send disabled with no explanation. Suggest hiding/disabling phone-less contacts or showing 'no phone on file'.
fetchConfig/fetchStats/fetchMessages/fetchContacts only console.error on failure - no visible error state; a backend outage silently renders an empty/'not configured' UI.
textarea has no maxLength although the UI shows an x/4096 counter - users can exceed the advertised limit and only find out from the provider error.
POST /api/whatsapp/send-bulk has no UI entry point at all - bulk sending is unreachable from the CRM.
STILL OPEN from iteration_28: table is capped at 50 rows of 91 with no pagination or 'showing 50 of 91' hint.

design_issues.screen: CRM (all views incl. WhatsApp) at 390x844 mobile
issues: Layout is not responsive: the sidebar keeps its full fixed width and never collapses, squeezing the content column to ~50px - inputs are unusable and the page overflows horizontally. Add a collapsible/drawer sidebar and md: breakpoints.
Send button uses white text on #25D366 (contrast ~2.0:1) - fails WCAG AA; use dark text or a darker green.
Placeholder/meta text uses #71717a on #09090b (~3.4:1) - below AA for small text.
Invalid CSS prop `focusRingColor` on the phone input style object (line 148) - a no-op React style key; use Tailwind focus:ring classes.
Progress bar track invisible at 0% sent (unchanged from iteration_28).

action_items: Add E.164/regex phone validation in POST /api/whatsapp/send and /send-bulk before calling Qikchat
Stop marking queued messages as 'sent'; use status='queued' and add a delivery-status update (webhook/poll) so stats are truthful
Persist the WhatsApp API key (DB or .env) instead of a module-level global, and validate it on save
Make object_storage calls non-blocking (asyncio.to_thread) and use metadata/HEAD instead of full downloads for cloud-assets/status
WhatsApp UI: handle phone-less CRM contacts, add visible API-error states, add maxLength=4096 on the textarea
Add pagination/'50 of 91' indicator to the campaign prospects table (carried over)
Fix mobile responsiveness of CRMLayout (collapsible sidebar)
Improve WhatsApp send-button contrast and remove the invalid focusRingColor style key
critical_code_review_comments: routes/whatsapp.py: QIKCHAT_API_KEY is read once at import into a module global that POST /config mutates - not multi-worker safe and lost on restart. Read from a config store per-request.
routes/whatsapp.py: full Qikchat api_response (provider payload) is persisted in Mongo and returned to the client on failure - can leak provider internals; store a trimmed subset.
routes/whatsapp.py: send and send-bulk duplicate ~25 lines of phone normalization + payload build + DB logging - extract a shared _send_one() helper (DRY).

routes/campaign_manager.py: _upload_campaign_assets (async, lines 45-59) and _upload_campaign_assets_inner (lines 140-154) are byte-identical duplicates; the async one is dead code. Also seed_myntra_campaign line 81 has a no-op `run_in_executor(None, lambda: None)`.
utils/object_storage.py uses sync `requests` throughout while every caller is an async FastAPI endpoint - blocks the event loop on 100-500KB transfers.
MYNTRA_CAMPAIGN_TEMPLATE still omits 'attachment_path' (flagged in iteration_28) - preview vs production doc parity gap remains.
Both route modules build their own module-level AsyncIOMotorClient with os.environ.get('MONGO_URL','') empty default - share one client and fail fast on missing config.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (with the header-title bug fixed by me)

seed_data_creation: One WhatsApp log row (contact_name=TEST_QA, +910000000000) was created by the controlled Qikchat validation send and deleted afterwards; whatsapp_messages is back to 0 documents. No campaign data modified.

All campaign + whatsapp endpoints are unauthenticated, so curl/requests work directly. The Qikchat API is LIVE - test_send_invalid_number_is_handled_gracefully performs one real (0-credit, queued) send; delete the resulting TEST_QA row from db.whatsapp_messages after runs. /api/campaigns/{id}/send-batch was NOT exercised (would send real LinkedIn messages). Mobile responsiveness of the whole CRM shell is broken - retest after any layout fix.
rca_of_the_issue: Header showed 'Dashboard' on the WhatsApp view because TopHeader.jsx VIEW_TITLES lacked a 'whatsapp' key and fell back to the default; added the key. The 'sent' status for an invalid number is a design gap, not a bug in transport: Qikchat's synchronous response only confirms queueing (status:true, per-message status 'processing'), while routes/whatsapp.py maps that directly to status='sent', so no delivery failure can ever be recorded without a webhook.
